steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each exception is placed by how often its cause repeats and whether a cause is recorded.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Cause repeated on three or more days
findings.fix: Fix the cause, not the symptom

findings.title: Workaround with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner to the workaround

findings.title: Exception with no cause and no note

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] exc-workaround-b:12  Cause repeated on three or more days.

[medium] exc-stock:19  Workaround with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner to the workaround.
[low] exc-delay-d:26  Exception with no cause and no note.

Not checked: Exceptions not logged.
pros: Checks a workaround with no owner, an exception with no cause and no note, and a repeated cause on three or more days.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-exception-log skill on the records for this review.
